question: In a certain code language, 'EAGER' is written as 'AEHRE' and 'GIRLS' is written as 'IGSSL'. How will 'ISSUE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First and second letter ⇒ Interchanged the positions.
 
• Third letter ⇒ (1) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourth and fifth letter ⇒ Interchanged the positions.

​So,

 
• 'EAGER' is written as 'AEHRE'​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7529ba9bcdda06c152e38b5f9fc85d0bfddb4dc2cebd28f71c92ffe37aa5e1f6.png] 

And,

 
• 'GIRLS' is written as 'IGSSL'​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8e052f5ce1923b08078cc2bc925011f05c6b537ff2d38e7544594a091abb6f1.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'ISSUE' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fa2c56d22f2872f60a60bb1cc744fde70d1de5039896c1b4eef09a8defc7f93.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**SITEU**".

73:T
